systems.country_label: property-tax reform pilot covering property identification and valuation
systems.owner: Addis Ababa City Government Revenues Bureau
systems.tiers: Addis Ababa; began July 2026; transition from land-rent and building-tax arrangement to value-based property tax

note: The Addis Ababa Revenues Bureau asked missions for lease and employee records, but the document states no revenue system or payer register; the pilot covers identification and valuation, a survey.
Passages state only that the January 2025 Property Tax Proclamation empowers municipalities to collect property tax; a law, no system or record stated.
Passages from the IMF tax administration assessment mention property taxes only as taxes the national tax administration collects; no local government record.
The passages name LGRCIS only for Tanzania; nothing stated for Ethiopia on local government revenue records.

facts.fact: The Computerized Property Tax Administration (CPTA) platform was developed in 2016 for three pilot cities and was never fully implemented, per the LoGRI project page (undated, year 2025 taken from its January 2025 proclamation).

The CPTA assessment is run with the Ministry of Urban and Infrastructure's Urban Revenue Reform Project Office and the Ministry of Finance's Tax Policy Department, with UNECA support; the page is dated 2025 by proxy.

facts.fact: The VNG International-backed ULGE project piloted e-billing and e-payment for property and land lease in Yirgalem city, under an April 2022 agreement with the Sidama Regional State and the municipality; the city then collected only 3 per cent of its potential tax.
The project page says property and land lease processes in Yirgalem were overhauled with e-billing and e-payment after a comprehensive update of property assessments.
